text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Joint committees on national dialogue have succeeded in forging a consensus pending a national conference in the next days.
- The Social and Economic National Council (CNES) ended two-day meeting to chart plans over population and industry.
- The next national conference between the authorities and political parties aims to end political adventurism in Algeria.
- Fourteen percent of Algerians hold half of the country's wealth, according to official figures.
